name: How quickly does water damage need to be addressed to prevent mold?

mainEntity.name: How quickly does water damage need to be addressed to prevent mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage needs to be addressed very quickly to prevent mold growth. Mold can start to develop within 24 to 48 hours after water exposure, especially in damp, warm conditions. The key is thorough drying and moisture removal. The longer water sits, the higher the risk of extensive mold contamination, which can require more complex and costly remediation. Prompt professional intervention ensures effective water extraction and drying, significantly reducing the chances of mold taking hold.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water damage should be addressed within 24-48 hours to prevent mold, which can start growing quickly in damp conditions.
